items.question: Do you provide free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. We provide clear, itemized written estimates. You may text photos for a quick first review or schedule an in-person visit.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured in NYC?
items.answer: Absolutely. We are licensed, bonded, and insured. NYC HIC #2131291. Certificates of insurance are available.

items.question: Do you handle permits?
items.answer: Yes. We provide permit guidance and work with appropriately licensed professionals for filings when a project requires them.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, the Bronx, and select New Jersey towns.

items.question: Do you serve all five NYC boroughs and New Jersey?
items.answer: Yes. We are based in Staten Island and serve all five NYC boroughs plus select New Jersey towns within our service radius.

items.question: Do you offer virtual estimates?
items.answer: Yes. You can text or email photos and videos for a fast first review without an appointment.

items.question: How do payments work?
items.answer: We take a deposit to schedule the project, followed by progress payments and a final payment at completion. Your written proposal explains the schedule.

items.question: Do you work with insurance companies for storm damage?
items.answer: We can provide a detailed scope, photos, and technical information for your insurance adjuster when storm damage affects your roof, siding, or fence.

items.question: Do you repair or replace roofs?
items.answer: Yes. We handle flat-roof systems common in Brooklyn and Queens, shingle roofing common in Staten Island and New Jersey, and roof repairs.

items.question: How do I know if I need a repair or a full replacement?
items.answer: A single isolated leak may only need repair. Multiple leaks, widespread damage, or an older failing roof may make replacement the better investment. We provide an honest on-site assessment.

items.question: How long does a roof replacement take?
items.answer: Many residential roof replacements take one to two days, depending on size, access, weather, decking condition, and the selected system.

items.question: Do you offer emergency or same-day repairs?
items.answer: We prioritize urgent issues such as active leaks, storm damage, loose masonry, and safety hazards when scheduling permits.

items.question: Can you match my existing brick color?
items.answer: Matching older New York City brick and mortar is one of our specialties. We source and tint materials to blend repairs with the existing facade as closely as possible.

items.question: Do you repair DOT sidewalk violations?
items.answer: Yes. We can handle demolition, permits, forming, concrete work, and the steps needed to prepare for violation dismissal.

items.question: Can I drive on my new driveway immediately?
items.answer: No. Concrete needs curing time. Site conditions and the selected material determine the exact wait, but heavy vehicles generally must stay off until the new work has properly cured.

items.question: Do you restore brownstones?
items.answer: Yes. We repair brownstone and historic masonry, match mortar colors, and restore facades with attention to their original character.

items.question: Who buys the materials?
items.answer: We normally supply rough construction materials. Finish materials such as tile, vanities, and fixtures are selected with you and handled according to the written proposal.

items.question: Will my property be a mess?
items.answer: We protect work areas, organize materials, and perform daily cleanup. The exact protection plan is matched to the project.

items.question: What happens if I want to change something mid-project?
items.answer: We document requested changes in writing with the added or reduced price and schedule impact before proceeding.

items.question: What happens if you find hidden damage behind walls?
items.answer: We stop, document the condition, explain the options, and provide written change-order pricing before additional work begins.

items.question: Do you work in the winter?
items.answer: Interior work continues year-round. Exterior masonry and roofing depend on safe weather and material temperature requirements.

items.question: Do you work on homes built before 1978?
items.answer: Yes. As an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm, we follow required containment, dust-control, and cleanup practices for covered work.

items.question: Do I need to move out during a remodel?
items.answer: Usually not for many kitchen, bathroom, basement, or painting projects. We discuss access, dust control, utilities, and safety before work begins.

items.question: Do you perform commercial work?
items.answer: Yes. We handle commercial masonry, roofing, exterior work, and renovation scopes, with scheduling options based on the property.

items.question: Do you offer warranties?
items.answer: Yes. Warranty coverage depends on the scope and materials and is described in the written contract for each project.

items.question: Do you have a loyalty program?
items.answer: Yes. Our free Signature Membership includes member perks and monthly opportunities. Visit the membership page for current details.
